desaturated graphic-novel panel, mature simplified cel-shaded anime characters, flat color blocks with hard-edged cel shadows, clean ink linework, cold grey-blue palette, one controlled warm practical light, ordinary Chinese urban interior or street, worn and lived-in surfaces, legible horror staging, clear foreground subject and evidence prop, slightly off-center composition, deep focus, layered foreground occlusion in wide shots, volumetric dust in cold window light, 16:9
2D cel animation key visual, flat unshaded color areas, hard-edged shadow shapes, no gradients on fabric or walls, clean black linework, anime screencap
Use the attached empty environment master for exact location and prop continuity. Output one complete scene. 
A narrow fresh scratch beside the apartment lock fills the left foreground while an old corridor monitor in the background shows grey static; no intruder, no readable numbers, no glitch effects beyond natural monitor snow.
Keep the same worn set and camera-readable evidence. No readable text, letters, numbers, symbols, platform logos, UI, subtitles or watermark.
